c0127:prove.body:
proof -
  have gap: "\<And>s n. \<lbrakk>is_aligned ptr n; n < 32; ps_clear ptr n s; {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). ptr < k} \<noteq> {}\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<not> Min {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). ptr < k} - ptr < 2 ^ n"
  proof -
    fix s n
    let ?A = "{k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). ptr < k}"
    assume al: "is_aligned ptr n" and n: "n < 32" and clear: "ps_clear ptr n s" and ne: "?A \<noteq> {}"
    have mem: "Min ?A \<in> ?A" by (rule Min_in[OF _ ne]; simp)
    show "\<not> Min ?A - ptr < 2 ^ n"
    proof
      assume lt: "Min ?A - ptr < 2 ^ n"
      have le: "ptr + (Min ?A - ptr) \<le> ptr + (2 ^ n - 1)"
        by (rule is_aligned_no_overflow3[OF al]; simp_all add: n lt)
      have mm: "Min ?A \<in> ({ptr..ptr + (1 << n) - 1} - {ptr}) \<inter> dom (ksPSpace s)"
        using mem le by (auto simp: shiftl_t2n field_simps intro: less_imp_le)
      show False using clear mm by (simp add: ps_clear_def)
    qed
  qed
  have get: "\<And>s ep. ko_at' ep ptr s \<Longrightarrow> getEndpoint ptr s = ({(ep,s)},False)"
  proof -
    fix s and ep :: "Structures_H.endpoint"
    assume at: "ko_at' ep ptr s"
    obtain ko where ko: "ksPSpace s ptr = Some ko" "is_aligned ptr (objBitsKO ko)" "ps_clear ptr (objBitsKO ko) s" "projectKO_opt ko = Some ep"
      using at by (auto simp: obj_at'_real_def ko_wp_at'_def)
    have eq: "ko = KOEndpoint ep" using ko(4) by (cases ko; simp add: projectKO_opts_defs)
    have no: "{k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). ptr < k} \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> \<not> Min {k \<in> dom (ksPSpace s). ptr < k} - ptr < 2 ^ objBitsKO (KOEndpoint ep)"
      using gap[OF ko(2) _ ko(3)] by (simp add: eq objBitsKO_def epSizeBits_def)
    show "getEndpoint ptr s = ({(ep,s)},False)" using ko(1-3) no
      apply (simp add: eq getEndpoint_def getObject_def loadObject_default_def projectKO_def projectKO_opts_defs psMap_def lookupAround2_def lookupAround_def maybeToMonad_def alignCheck_def magnitudeCheck_def gets_def get_def bind_def return_def assert_def assert_opt_def fail_def unless_def when_def objBits_def is_aligned_mask Let_def)
      done
  qed
  have abs: "\<And>s ep. kheap s ptr = Some (Endpoint ep) \<Longrightarrow> get_endpoint ptr s = ({(ep,s)},False)"
    by (simp add: get_simple_ko_def get_object_def gets_def get_def bind_def return_def assert_def a_type_def partial_inv_def)
  have sim: "\<And>s s'. \<lbrakk>(s,s') \<in> state_relation; ep_at ptr s; ep_at' ptr s'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>ep ep'. get_endpoint ptr s = ({(ep,s)},False) \<and> getEndpoint ptr s' = ({(ep',s')},False) \<and> ep_relation ep ep'"
  proof -
    fix s s'
    assume sr: "(s,s') \<in> state_relation" and a: "ep_at ptr s" and c: "ep_at' ptr s'"
    obtain ak where ak: "kheap s ptr = Some ak" "is_ep ak" using a by (auto simp: obj_at_def)
    obtain ep where "ak = Endpoint ep" using ak(2) by (cases ak; auto simp: is_ep_def)
    then have ep: "kheap s ptr = Some (Endpoint ep)" using ak(1) by simp
    obtain ep' :: "Structures_H.endpoint" where ep': "ko_at' ep' ptr s'"
      using c by (auto simp: obj_at'_real_def ko_wp_at'_def)
    obtain ck where ck: "ksPSpace s' ptr = Some ck" "projectKO_opt ck = Some ep'"
      using ep' by (auto simp: obj_at'_real_def ko_wp_at'_def)
    have "ck = KOEndpoint ep'" using ck(2) by (cases ck; simp add: projectKO_opts_defs)
    then have heap: "ksPSpace s' ptr = Some (KOEndpoint ep')" using ck(1) by simp
    have ps: "pspace_relation (kheap s) (ksPSpace s')" using sr by (simp add: state_relation_def)
    have rr: "other_obj_relation (Endpoint ep) (KOEndpoint ep')"
      using ps ep heap unfolding pspace_relation_def
      by (elim conjE; drule_tac x=ptr in bspec; simp_all)
    have rel: "ep_relation ep ep'" using rr by (simp add: other_obj_relation_def)
    show "\<exists>ep ep'. get_endpoint ptr s = ({(ep,s)},False) \<and> getEndpoint ptr s' = ({(ep',s')},False) \<and> ep_relation ep ep'"
      using abs[OF ep] get[OF ep'] rel by blast
  qed
  show ?thesis using sim by (fastforce simp: corres_underlying_def)
qed
